entries.back_en: "L-let's go! Let's do what she says!"
"Well, that wasn't exactly what we expected, but... I'm sure everything will work out in the end."
"Are you going to explore the island? Can I come along?"
entries.note: 'I hope you don't mind' simplificado p/ 'Posso ir junto?', mas sentido mantido.

entries.back_en: "It looks like it's going down. Let's go see!"
entries.note: 'going out' (mare?) traduzido como 'baixando'; ambiguo mas plausivel.
